pages.title: The Fire Remembers
pages.text: Ordinary, Corrupt and Enchanted Souls remain in the Clibano soul slot without being consumed. They grant processing speeds of 1.25x, 1.5x and 2.5x respectively.

pages.title: Burn the Soul out of Sand
pages.text: With a Corrupt or Enchanted Soul in the slot, each Soul Sand produces one ordinary Soul, with Soulless Sand as residue.
